title: One Piece Holy Knights Trailer Introduces Shamrock, Gunko, Sommers & Killingham
content: ONE PIECE revealed a new trailer introducing the Holy Knights, introducing the voice cast for Shamrock, Gunko, Sommers and Killigham. Episode 1164 is set to premiere on Sunday, May 31.
author: Anime Corner

title: K Manga Adds Ema Toyama's A Thousand Years Behind the Veil Manga
content: Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Thursday that it has added Ema Toyama 's A Thousand Years Behind the Veil ( Sen-nen no Hanayome ) manga and Aika and Meshiko Iida 's The Tale of How My Cheap, Stingy Sister-in-Law Lost It All ( Sekokechi Gimai ga Subete o Ushinatta Hanashi ) manga in English.
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling Sets a Record No Anime Has Ever Achieved on Crunchyroll
content: It has now been a little over two years since the Solo Leveling anime made its debut on Crunchyroll, and in that short span of time, the anime has secured a position on the platform that no other anime ever has. Ever since its debut, Solo Leveling has continued its trend of capturing attention and breaking records.
author: ComicBook

title: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring Gets TV Anime Adaptation
content: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring (Hitodzukiai ga nigate na mibojin no Yuki-onna to Noroi no Yubiwa) is officially getting a TV anime adaptation. The story is described: A widowed snow woman × a human young man. Will the “cursed ring” suddenly bring them much closer together…?
author: Anime Corner

title: Code Geass Franchise Gets New Smartphone Game This Year
content: Game developer JORO announced on Friday it is developing the Code Geass Knightmare Survivor game for iOS and Android, slated for release this year. Pre-registration is available now. The "survivor action" game will be free to play, with optional in-game purchases.
author: ANN

title: Magical Explorer Anime Casts Saori Ōnishi
content: The official website for the television anime of Iris and Noboru Kannatsuki 's Magical Explorer light novel series revealed a new cast member and a new visual on Friday. Saori Ōnishi will play Yukine Mizumori. The character is pictured at right in the below new teaser visual.
author: ANN

title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects Anime Reveals Theme Songs, July 10 Debut in Video
content: The official website for the television anime of Fuurou 's The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects ( Ryōmin 0-nin Start no Henkyō Ryōshu-sama ) light novel series revealed a second promotional video on Friday, along with the show's July 10 debut, more cast, and the opening and ending theme song artists.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Uchuujin MuuMuu' Concludes Seven-Year Serialization
content: Hiroki Miyashita 's Uchuujin MuuMuu ( Me and the Alien Mumu ) manga has concluded in the July 2026 issue of Young King OURs on May 29, marking the end of its nearly 7-year-long serialization. Miyashita began serializing the comedy sci-fi manga in Young King OURs magazine in June 2019.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Ryoumin 0-nin Start no Henkyou Ryoushu-sama' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Fuurou 's Ryoumin 0-nin Start no Henkyou Ryoushu-sama ( The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects: The Blue-Horned Maiden ) revealed additional cast, staff, the theme songs, and second promotional video on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Iwamoto-senpai no Suisen' Reveals Supporting Cast, Theme Songs
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Hiroshi Shiibashi 's Iwamoto-senpai no Suisen ( Recommendation from Mr. Iwamoto ) manga announced a supporting pair of cast and theme songs on Friday. The anime will premiere on Tokyo MX at 10.30 p.m. followed by Sun TV every Saturday beginning July 4.
author: MyAnimeList
